about_the_game:
Welcome to The Newbie Hacker – an interactive fiction that casts you as an intelligence analyst. Your job is to sift through seemingly ordinary online activities and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the torrent of data. You will monitor your target's digital footprint in real-time: emails, shopping records, private messages... every highlighted keyword is a piece of the puzzle. The real challenge lies in cross-referencing these fragments within a vast internal encyclopedia to unearth personal relationships, lies, loopholes, and clandestine deals.

For instance, from an email requesting a change in delivery time, combined with records of medication purchases and rumors of a corporate acquisition, can you deduce that this is a meticulously planned corporate espionage operation? Or, by piecing together login traces from a hotel management system and a social dating app, can you reconstruct the complete timeline of an extramarital affair? Your deductions will drive the plot – whether you choose to confront the target directly or assume a fake identity to probe further, each decision leads to different branches of the truth.

Beyond the core gameplay of surveillance and deduction, you'll also need to learn and customize hacking tools to unlock deeper levels of online activity. At the same time, you must manage your daily schedule wisely, allocating limited resources between monitoring, research, and interaction tasks to ensure no crucial clue is missed. Are you ready to accept the challenge? The truth awaits only the most perceptive observer.
